en-US.author: Astral Software Inc.
en-US.description: An extremely fast Python type checker and language server, written in Rust.
en-US.name: ty
en-US.releaseNotes:
Bug fixes
- Avoid cubic narrowing for enum OR patterns (#30019)
- Avoid duplicate warnings for unknown rules and override sections (#30028)
- Fix class-pattern exhaustiveness after class identity checks (#30045)
- Fix conditional type and tuple annotations (#29987)
- Prefer active unnamed Conda and Pixi environments (#29974)
- Preserve baseline matches when a rule is renamed (#30040)
- Preserve exception types after tuple truthiness checks (#30018)
- Report invalid module globs once per override pattern (#30031)
- Skip active Conda and Pixi environments during discovery if the environment doesn't contain Python (#30066)

Configuration changes
- Don't fail configuration deserialization on conflicting rule names (#30023)
- Inherit project settings and overrides for PEP 723 scripts (#29793)
- Warn when configuration uses a renamed rule (#30024)

Memory usage improvements
- Reuse callable signatures in function definition checks (#30042)

Other changes
- Retain all successful generic call narrowing attempts (#29666)
- Reuse specialized ancestors in class relations (#29881)
- Support shadowing methods on instances (#29482)
- Warn about renamed rules in ignore comments (#30026)
